# Plex (`plex`)

Whether a Plex Media Server is up and accepts its token. Read-only: nothing is played or changed.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/plex`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/plex/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/plex/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `service` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- HTTP to the device, port 32400
- HTTPS to the device, port 32400

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Server URL | URL (http, https) | yes |  | The server's base URL: scheme, host and port only, such as http://192.0.2.20:32400. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | Token | yes | The server's X-Plex-Token. Sent only in the X-Plex-Token header, never in a URL. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.
